learning_outcomes.text: Know and apply different maintenance and machine diagnosis techniques.
Plan machine maintenance and evaluate their condition (breakages, corrosion, etc.).
Able to work in a team, apply critical reasoning, make decisions, and communicate knowledge and conclusions in the field of industrial engineering.

syllabus_topics: Maintenance and machine diagnosis: Definition and types of maintenance.
Maintenance function, profitability, availability, and maintenance management.
Applications and limitations in maintenance management.
Organization of maintenance resources. Stock control.
Modes and mechanisms of degradation in service.
Stress and deformations in machine elements and plant components and their significance.
Ductile-brittle transition in mechanical components. Pellini design.
Cracks due to fatigue, stress-corrosion, and corrosion-fatigue.
Modern theory of wet corrosion and its implications for maintenance.
Methods of protection and control for wet corrosion.
Nature of oxidation of metallic materials and its implication in design and maintenance.
Forms of control and protection for dry corrosion.
assessment_rules: The final grade is based on two written exams: a mid-term exam (55%) and a final exam (45%). For continuous assessment, a minimum of 3.5 points is required in each of the two exams to average their scores. Students who do not pass through continuous assessment must take a comprehensive exam in the ordinary/extraordinary sitting, which will count for 100% of the final grade.
